paragraphs.paragraph_text: Supplier capacity constraints and higher input costs could reduce our ability to meet demand and may pressure gross margins. During the current reporting period, we have observed longer lead times and less predictable supplier capacity, which may increase working-capital requirements.
Regulatory reviews and legal proceedings could result in additional expenses, operational restrictions, penalties, or reputational harm.
Changes in customer purchasing behavior may make demand less predictable and increase sales volatility.
If we cannot pass increased costs to customers, our operating margins and cash flow could be adversely affected.

Management continues to monitor revenue growth, operating expenses, working capital, and capital allocation. Results may be affected by customer demand, product mix, foreign exchange movements, and changes in the cost of operations. These statements are illustrative synthetic content created for software testing and are not extracted from an actual filing.
